title: REQ · BootScene maps Tab, arrows, Enter, Space and Escape to focus, select and close events
description: Context: BootScene.create builds SceneObjects but registers no keyboard listener. Desired: a keydown listener where Tab/ArrowRight/ArrowDown call moveFocus(+1), Shift+Tab/ArrowLeft/ArrowUp call moveFocus(-1) and emit focusChange, Enter/Space call handleKey on the focused object (which emits objectClick), and Escape emits menuClose. The listener is removed on shutdown.
acceptance_criteria: Given two visible objects, when Tab is pressed, then the first gets focus and focusChange is emitted with its id.
Given a focused object, when Enter or Space is pressed, then objectClick is emitted with its id.
Given any state, when Escape is pressed, then menuClose is emitted.
Given scene shutdown, then the keydown listener is removed.

preserve: Existing create, sync and shutdown behavior

definition_of_done: All five keys behave as specified
